patterns.name: Ask, don’t gather
patterns.desc: Instead of opening six tabs before a call, ask for the brief.

patterns.name: Pull live, don’t paste
patterns.desc: Instead of pasting CRM notes into Claude, let it pull from Backstory, so it’s up to date with what Backstory has captured.

patterns.name: Be specific, not general
patterns.desc: Instead of “How’s my pipeline?”, ask a question with a filter, a time window and a signal.

intro: Change the habit, and Claude stops being an extra step. It does the gathering, and you start from the answer. Every card applies one of three shifts. Small changes, big impact.

progression.heading: What changes as the habit sticks
progression.intro: Start with one prompt. Within a few weeks it’s routine, and the time you used to spend gathering goes back to customers.

roles.name: Account executive
steps: Prep one call by asking for a brief instead of opening tabs.
Morning prep takes minutes. Follow-ups start from captured notes.
You ask sharper questions and spot quiet deals before they go cold.

roles.name: Sales manager
steps: Prep one 1:1 from Backstory instead of a status readout.
Every standing meeting has a prompt. Forecast prep runs on evidence.
Coaching time goes to the deals that need a decision.

roles.name: Customer success
steps: Ask for a 30-day summary on one renewing account.
Handoffs and QBR outlines start from what was captured.
Quiet contacts and book risk surface while there’s time to act.

practices: Start with “Using Backstory” so Claude pulls live data.
Add an account, a time window and a signal.
“What dates and people is that based on?”
Tie one prompt to a meeting you already run.

roles.name: Account executive
roles.tagline: Prep, follow-up and deal strategy, without the tab hunt.

groups.title: Before the call
groups.heading: Ask for the brief. Let it pull live.

swaps.title: Pre-call prep
swaps.instead: Opening six tabs before a call.
swaps.ask: Help me prep for my call with Vantage Retail.
swaps.why: One ask replaces the hunt, and every line comes from captured activity.

swaps.title: Deal updates
swaps.instead: Pasting CRM notes into Claude and hoping they’re current.
swaps.ask: What’s the latest on the Vantage Retail deal?
swaps.why: It pulls from Backstory, so it’s up to date with what Backstory has captured.

groups.title: Sharpen the question
groups.heading: Add a filter, a time window and a signal

swaps.title: Pipeline check
swaps.ask: Which of my deals closing this quarter have nothing on the calendar in the next 30 days?
swaps.why: Result: a to-do list, not a vague summary.

highlights.text: nothing on the calendar in the next 30 days

swaps.note: Before you confirm, check that Backstory’s reading of the list says your deals.

swaps.title: Stakeholder map
swaps.instead: Rebuilding the buying group from memory.
swaps.ask: Using Backstory, who have we been talking to at Vantage Retail in the last 30 days, and when?
swaps.why: See who’s engaged and when you last spoke, from captured activity.
swaps.note: To find gaps, ask “Who at Vantage Retail should we be talking to that we aren’t?” Names can change each time, so check them against your account plan.

swaps.title: Deal risk
swaps.ask: Any risks on the Vantage Retail deal?
swaps.why: Backstory flags the same risks each time. Ask “What dates and people is that based on?” for the evidence.

groups.title: After the call
groups.heading: Start from what’s captured, not from memory

swaps.title: Follow-up email
swaps.instead: Copying meeting notes into an email and rewriting them as a recap.
swaps.ask: Write a follow-up email with the next steps from my recent Vantage Retail meetings.

mock.title: Draft
mock.subject: Next steps from our recent meetings
mock.body: Thanks for the time, Jordan. As agreed: revised pricing by Friday, security review kickoff next week, and a working session with your ops team on the 14th.

swaps.note: Check owners and dates before you send.

swaps.title: Precedent
swaps.instead: Asking around Slack for someone who’s closed a deal like this.
swaps.ask: Have we had a deal like the Vantage Retail deal before? How’d it go?
swaps.why: Finds similar deals at other customers, where your organization has turned this on. You may get a different set each time.
swaps.note: Some matches may still be open. Treat them as examples.

roles.name: Sales manager
roles.tagline: Forecasts, 1:1s and coaching, grounded in what reps actually did.

groups.title: The weekly rhythm
groups.heading: Swap the prep behind every standing meeting

swaps.title: Coaching focus
swaps.instead: Coaching from gut feel on who’s struggling.
swaps.ask: Which of my team’s accounts have engagement under 30?
swaps.why: Coach from facts, not hunches. Low engagement shows where to spend time.
swaps.note: If “my team” comes back empty, name the rep instead: “Priya Raman’s accounts”.

swaps.title: 1:1 prep
swaps.instead: Asking the rep to walk through every deal.
swaps.ask: What deals does Priya Raman have closing this quarter? Give me the risks and next steps on each.
swaps.why: Backstory has the status. The 1:1 can start at coaching instead of a deal-by-deal readout.

swaps.title: Forecast prep
swaps.instead: Exporting the pipeline to a spreadsheet.
swaps.ask: What are my team’s 10 biggest deals closing this quarter?
swaps.why: The forecast call starts from the deals that matter most, not a rep’s recall.
swaps.note: Check that Backstory read “biggest” as highest first. It can’t read forecast categories yet.

groups.title: Inspect with structure
groups.heading: Give the answer a framework you can coach against

swaps.title: Deal inspection
swaps.ask: Evaluate the Halden Freight opportunity using MEDDPICC and flag the gaps.
swaps.why: A framework turns “I think so” into specific gaps to close.
swaps.note: Swap in the methodology your team uses, such as MEDDIC, BANT, SPICED or Challenger.

groups.title: See across the team
groups.heading: Let patterns surface, instead of hunting for them

swaps.title: At-risk deals
swaps.instead: Reading every call summary to find deals going cold.
swaps.ask: Which of my team’s deals closing this quarter have engagement under 50?
swaps.why: A short list of deals to ask about next.
swaps.note: To rank them by risk, ask about the risks on each deal that matters.

swaps.title: Stalled deals
swaps.instead: Finding out at the forecast call that a deal has stalled.
swaps.ask: Which of Priya Raman’s deals have nothing on the calendar in the next 30 days?
swaps.why: Nothing booked ahead is the early sign. Ask about those deals now.

mock.title: Nothing on the calendar · next 30 days

roles.name: Customer success
roles.tagline: Handoffs, renewals and expansion, with the full account story on hand.

groups.title: One account, four moments
groups.heading: Corvia Health, from handoff to expansion

swaps.title: Sales handoff
swaps.instead: A 30-minute handoff call to learn what was promised.
swaps.ask: What did we agree to do for Corvia Health, and who’s on the hook?
swaps.why: Start day one knowing every commitment and its owner.
swaps.note: Covers the last 30 days. For the longer story, ask “I just took over Corvia Health. Give me the history in five bullets.” and check key dates against your CRM.

swaps.title: QBR prep
swaps.instead: Building the QBR deck from a blank page.
swaps.ask: Ask Backstory’s assistant what the big themes have been with Corvia Health over the last 90 days.
swaps.why: Walk in with the quarter already summarized.
swaps.note: Then ask for the QBR outline. Themes come back undated.

swaps.title: Renewal prep
swaps.instead: Piecing the renewal story together the week before.
swaps.ask: Any risks on the Corvia Health renewal deal?
swaps.why: Spot renewal risk while there’s time to act.

swaps.title: Expansion
swaps.ask: Who at Corvia Health should we be talking to that we aren’t?
swaps.why: Find new people to meet before a competitor does.
swaps.note: Names can change each time, so check them against your account plan.

groups.title: Catch signals early
groups.heading: See the drop-off while there’s time to act

swaps.title: Quiet contacts
swaps.instead: Finding out your champion left when an email bounces.
swaps.ask: Who’s active at Corvia Health right now?
swaps.why: If your champion isn’t on the list, that’s your signal.

swaps.title: Book health
swaps.instead: Scanning your book account by account.
swaps.ask: Which of my accounts have engagement under 30?
swaps.why: One filter turns a whole book into a short list.
swaps.note: Before you confirm, check that Backstory’s reading of the list says your accounts.
